claims.assertion: Athena divides base-12 toroidal dynamics into expansion group 1,2,4,5,7,8,10,11 and contraction group 3,6,9,12.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She says the groups carry opposite, equivalent charges.

claims.assertion: She says Tesla’s popular 3-6-9 scheme omits 10-12; balanced opposite frequencies produce a spark in a zero-point reactor.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She says the nine-number diagram is unbalanced.

claims.assertion: Athena describes matter-energy nodes as standing toroidal waves formed when gravity harmonics recycle spherical emissions; an electron is a small toroid.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She treats matter and energy as equivalent.

review_flags: base-12, zero-point-reactor, and matter-wave claims are attributed to Athena and are not independently verified
